text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> achieved top-class results in the test 
tournament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the participants are filled with 
fulfillment, already firing up their 
competitive spirits for the main 
tournament. Of course, that includes <chrname> as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—Ryoka Tsurugi looked back 
on the event. Operations went smoothly, 
and feedback from the athletes was high. 
On the other hand... public attention 
remained low.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something was still missing to truly 
captivate the public. Ryoka Tsurugi 
pondered her next move, aiming to reach a 
brand-new demographic.
